title: Kadokawa CEO Takeshi Natsuno Retains Positions After Shareholder Vote
content: Takeshi Natsuno retains his positions as both the CEO and a board member of Kadokawa , after receiving enough votes during the company's 12th annual general meeting of shareholders on Wednesday.

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Manga Tops Oricon's Monthly Comic Ranking for June 2026
content: The 32nd volume of Taiki Kawakami 's That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ( Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken ) manga, based on Fuse and Mitz Vah 's light novel series of the same title, ranked at #1 selling 270,780 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on June 9.

title: Go! Go! Loser Ranger! Manga Goes on Hiatus Until August Due to Creator's Health
content: This year's 32nd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Wednesday that Negi Haruba 's Go, Go, Loser Ranger! ( Sentai Daishikkaku ) manga will go on hiatus due to Haruba's health, and will resume sometime in August.

title: Live-Action In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Film's Trailer Reveals Theme Song
content: The official website for the live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga presented a new trailer on Thursday. The trailer announces and previews the theme song "Moonlit" by Naniwa Danshi .

title: Renowned One Piece Animator Teases a Major Plan For The Best Flashback Ever
